biography: Tom Coronel, a Dutch dynamo with a shock of blonde curls and piercing green eyes, burst onto the racing scene with a raw, untamed aggression that both thrilled and terrified spectators. Growing up near Zandvoort, the roar of engines was his lullaby. His father, a weekend club racer, noticed Tom's preternatural feel for speed early on, gifting him a kart at the tender age of eight. Tom didn't just drive it; he wrestled it, pushing the machine and himself to the absolute limit. One particularly memorable incident involved him completely writing off the kart after attempting to overtake three rivals at once – a testament to his fearless, if somewhat reckless, approach. His early success in karting quickly translated into a scholarship to a junior formula series. While he showed flashes of brilliance, his aggressive style often led to costly mistakes. After a brief, unsuccessful stint in Formula Renault, Coronel found his true calling in GT racing, initially with a Dodge Viper GTS team. Now, at 25, and switching to Nissan, he's still considered a rising talent, albeit one who needs to temper his aggression with strategic thinking to truly reach his full potential.
drivingStyle: Coronel's driving style is characterized by relentless aggression. He's a late-braking master, often diving down the inside of opponents in seemingly impossible overtaking maneuvers. While his car control is impressive, his tire management leaves much to be desired, often pushing the rubber to its absolute limit in the early stages of a race, leaving him vulnerable in the closing laps. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest, but his tendency to overdrive can sometimes lead to unforced errors.

rivalries.name: Alessandro Rossi
rivalries.reason: A clash of egos dating back to their Formula Renault days; Rossi, a methodical strategist, openly criticized Coronel's reckless style.

rivalries.name: Eva Rostova
rivalries.reason: Their intense battles on track in the GT series often resulted in paint swapping and accusations of blocking.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka, a veteran driver known for his calm demeanor, views Coronel as an impetuous upstart who lacks respect for the traditions of racing.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, which are now threadbare and smell faintly of motor oil.
Listens to Dutch techno music at ear-splitting volume right before entering the car.
Refuses to look at the starting grid until five minutes before the race, claiming it jinxes his chances.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about finesse; it's about controlled chaos. If you're not pushing the limit, you're wasting your time."
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours in his rookie year with the Dodge Viper team, making a daring last-lap overtake to secure the victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the Nürburgring 24 Hours after misjudging a corner, costing his team a likely victory and severely damaging his confidence.
